description: Meta MMS-300M multilingual CTC forced aligner (Wav2Vec2ForCTC) that aligns an exact transcript to mono/stereo audio and returns word timestamps. The checkpoint covers 1,130 languages, but this port's native text normalization supports Dutch (nl/nld) and English (en/eng) Latin script only; text_normalization=pre_romanized accepts caller-supplied ASCII romanization, and unsupported non-Latin input is rejected. Checkpoint license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; GGUF conversion is local-only, no public redistribution is approved.

request.name: language
request.description: Transcript language; accepts nl/nld and en/eng, canonicalized internally to ISO 639-3 (nld/eng). Required for alignment.

request.name: text_normalization
request.description: Transcript normalization mode; latin handles Dutch/English Latin script natively, pre_romanized trusts caller-supplied ASCII romanization.

request.name: return_timestamps
request.description: Request word timestamps in the result; set automatically by --words-out.

session.name: emission_window_sec
session.description: Center emission window length in seconds used to split long waveforms; default 30.

session.name: emission_context_sec
session.description: Left/right context appended to each emission window in seconds; must be below emission_window_sec; default 2.

session.name: max_alignment_cells
session.description: Hard cap on CTC DP cells (frames x states) allocated per request; alignment fails before allocation when exceeded; default 50000000.

session.name: max_target_tokens
session.description: Hard cap on flattened CTC target tokens per request; default 8192.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Weight storage type; default native (tensors kept as stored in the checkpoint).

download.reason: CC-BY-NC-4.0 checkpoint: convert locally with audiocpp_gguf; no public audio.cpp GGUF distribution is approved.
